title: Unforgettable experience
text: A fantastic experience in the sea in front of Barcelona. The boat is comfortable and very well maintained, with pleasant music and a relaxed Mood that makes you disconnect completely. From the start we felt very welcome and the whole tour was full of interesting details about the city and the coast. The views are spectacular and the crossing is quiet, perfect to enjoy both as a couple and with friends. It is rating that the team loves what it does and transmits that passion to passengers. Undoubtedly, an activity I would recommend to anyone who wants to live Barcelona from a different and spec
